summary: Story 132.7 records failure, load, backup, and restore validation readiness only. It inventories required future failure scenarios, bounded synthetic load evidence, backup/restore validation evidence, observability/audit requirements, and fail-closed non-goals without executing drills, generating load, running destructive restores, mutating production hosts, or activating production.

execution_policy.required_statement: Story 132.7 is a readiness-only validation contract; live failure drills, destructive restores, load generation, and production mutation remain deferred until a later approved activation story supplies operator evidence.

failure_scenarios.expected_evidence: Health/readiness degradation, retry/backoff behavior, operator-facing recovery notes, and no production mutation.
Trace-correlated service boundary failure, backpressure behavior, and fail-closed recovery decision evidence.
Pool saturation thresholds, rate-limit preservation, bounded queue/backpressure metrics, and no unbounded retries.
Task/session recovery timeline, sanitized logs, trace IDs, and idempotency evidence.
Spawner recovery timeline, worktree lock ownership evidence, sanitized logs, and no duplicate authority.
Registry API/state health/readiness recovery, event replay status, and trace-correlated operator timeline.
MCP boundary failure classification, fail-closed approval/capability behavior, and sanitized logs.
Append-authority error evidence, replay/order preservation, recovery timeline, and no secret material.
Pre-migration backup identity, single-runner failure evidence, rollback/fix-forward decision, and schema revision state.
Checksum or manifest mismatch handling, isolated restore refusal/rollback evidence, and destructive restore confirmation boundary.

metrics.latency: required p50/p95/p99 latency budget evidence for each approved target surface
metrics.error: required error-rate and failure-class evidence with fail-closed thresholds
metrics.backpressure: required queue, retry, event-log lag, and worker backpressure metrics

load_validation.pool_saturation_thresholds: required per-instance and aggregate DB pool saturation thresholds below database limits
load_validation.rate_limit_preservation: required evidence that existing rate limits and fairness remain preserved under bounded synthetic load
load_validation.trace_correlation: required trace IDs across load driver, ingress, registry, worker, MCP, event-log, and recovery events

backup_restore_validation.pre_migration_backup: required before any future migration or restore drill
backup_restore_validation.checksum_manifest_validation: required checksum or immutable manifest validation before restore proceeds
backup_restore_validation.isolated_restore: required scratch/isolated restore target; live production restore remains forbidden by this story
backup_restore_validation.schema_version_compatibility: required Alembic/schema version compatibility evidence between source, backup, and restored target
backup_restore_validation.point_in_time_freshness: required recovery point objective timestamp/freshness evidence for the selected backup or replica
backup_restore_validation.rollback_fix_forward_decision: required operator decision record choosing rollback or fix-forward after partial/failing restore evidence
backup_restore_validation.destructive_restore_confirmation: required explicit future confirmation boundary before any destructive restore; Story 132.7 does not provide or execute it

observability_and_audit.health_readiness_signals: required service health/readiness degradation and recovery signals for each failure scenario
observability_and_audit.sanitized_logs: required logs with secrets, credentials, DSNs, hostnames, certificate data, and token material redacted
observability_and_audit.trace_ids: required trace IDs linking request, worker, MCP, event-log, backup/restore, and recovery evidence
observability_and_audit.recovery_timeline: required timeline with detection, mitigation, recovery, and operator decision timestamps

safety_boundaries.required_statement: Failure/load/backup/restore validation is readiness-only and fail-closed; live destructive operation, backup pruning, production restore, host mutation, credential values, and runtime audit emitters are not added.

validates: readiness-only mode, deferred production activation, and execution policy forbidding live drills destructive restores load generation and production mutation
